Если видео всё равно зависает, отключите QUIC в браузере и выключите блокировщик рекламы. Универсального решения сейчас нет: результат зависит от провайдера и меняется со временем. Если не помогло ничего, нужен VPN.

test_targets.geo_block_signature: HTTP 204 with an empty body proves only that the TLS path is open. NXDOMAIN from the system resolver but real IPs via DoH = DNS (NSDI) block. YouTube does not geo-block Russia itself.
Baseline is about 873 KB (US). Headers arrive, then the body stalls after about 16-25 KB = network throttling, not a geo-block.
2,888 B JPEG. A failure here while www.youtube.com works = missing thumbnails.
About 700 KB text. This is the video-host throughput test: measure kbps and repeat over at least 30 s. A low rate or a stall = googlevideo throttling. A 204 on /generate_204 is not enough.

services.advice_ru: Это ограничение провайдера на зарубежный хостинг, а не блокировка конкретного сайта. Стратегия иногда помогает, но не гарантированно. Отключите ECH в браузере. Если сайт всё равно зависает, нужен VPN.

test_targets.geo_block_signature: Must return exactly 65,536 B. Headers arriving and then a stall after about 16-25 KB = throttling. NOTE: bytes=16384 cannot detect the cut.
Baseline about 1.3 MB.
87,533 B exact baseline.

services.name: Сайты на зарубежном хостинге (Hetzner, DigitalOcean, OVH, AWS, Akamai)
services.blocker: rkn_throttle: the same 16-20 KB (about 25-packet) limit has been reported for Hetzner and DigitalOcean since June 2025, and the hyperion checker includes AWS, Akamai, Fastly and others. OVH had a separate UDP-triggered HTTPS block from late May 2025, and some OVH subnets appear whitelisted (Feb 2026).
services.what_users_see_ru: Небольшие сайты и сервисы на зарубежных серверах грузятся наполовину и зависают.
services.advice_ru: Это ограничение провайдера на зарубежный хостинг. Обход помогает не всегда, проверяйте на своей сети. Если не помогло, нужен VPN.

test_targets.geo_block_signature: Expect 206 with 65,536 B; an explicit Range header is required. A stall after about 16-25 KB = throttling. Mirrors: nbg1-speed.hetzner.com, hel1-speed.hetzner.com.

services.name: Защищённый DNS (DoH/DoT)
services.blocker: partial interception: around 25-26 Aug 2026 users on Rostelecom, Dom.ru, Tattelecom and SkyNet reported 1.1.1.1/1.0.0.1:853 resetting after TCP connect, and dns.google/8.8.8.8:443 hanging after ClientHello. One source (mentoday 2026-08-31) says plain UDP DNS to 8.8.8.8/1.1.1.1 is redirected to NSDI (answers from 195.208.5.1). The mechanism is unconfirmed and varies by operator.
services.what_users_see_ru: Включённый «безопасный DNS» в браузере перестаёт работать, сайты пишут «адрес не найден».
services.advice_ru: Программа проверит несколько DNS-серверов и выберет рабочий. Если не работает ни один, часть сервисов останется недоступной без VPN.

test_targets.geo_block_signature: JSON with an Answer array = DoH works. A hang or EOF after ClientHello = DoH blocked on this network.
200 JSON only when the accept header is sent; a 400 without it is NOT a block.

detection.rule: All Russian controls fail: TCP 443 connect to ya.ru, vk.com and www.gosuslugi.ru, plus system DNS resolution of ya.ru. Also check that Windows has a default gateway and an adapter that is up. Run this first; skip all further tests if it fails.
detection.message_ru: Нет подключения к интернету: не открываются даже российские сайты. Проверьте кабель, Wi-Fi или роутер. Программа обхода тут ни при чём.

detection.rule: Russian whitelisted endpoints (ya.ru, vk.com, www.gosuslugi.ru → HTTP 200) work, but ALL foreign controls on different ASNs time out or are refused at TCP connect, including by raw IP. Use several controls, e.g. a Hetzner IP, telegram.org, discord.com and a Google host; do NOT use example.com, which is now on Cloudflare. Also check whether the active adapter is WWAN/cellular or a phone hotspot. Retest after 5-10 min, since the mode varies by operator, region and SIM. Probes are read-only HTTPS/TCP connects; no spoofing or scanning.
detection.message_ru: Похоже, на вашей мобильной сети включён режим «белых списков»: работают только разрешённые российские сервисы. Никакая программа обхода тут не поможет. Подключитесь к домашнему Wi-Fi или проводному интернету.

detection.rule: Resolve the target via the system resolver and via DoH (dns.google/resolve JSON, cloudflare-dns.com with accept: application/dns-json, at least one more). Classify as a DNS block if the system resolver gives NXDOMAIN, an empty answer, a private/bogon IP or an IP that differs from every DoH answer, while DoH returns real addresses. Optional: a plain UDP query to 8.8.8.8 answered from 195.208.5.1 = interception (single source). Run before any DPI test.
detection.message_ru: Ваш провайдер не выдаёт настоящий адрес этого сайта (подмена DNS). Включите защищённый DNS — программа может сделать это одной кнопкой.

detection.rule: Every configured DoH/DoT resolver hangs, resets after TCP connect or returns EOF after ClientHello. Try at least three providers from the Flowseal list and report which work.
detection.message_ru: На вашей сети заблокированы и защищённые DNS-серверы. Мы попробовали несколько: часть сервисов может остаться недоступной без VPN.

detection.rule: DNS resolves to correct IPs, but TCP connect to the IP:443 times out or gets RST before any TLS byte is sent. Also fails when connecting with a neutral SNI or no SNI to the same IP, while foreign controls on other networks connect fine. For Telegram, also check TCP connect to 149.154.167.220:443.
detection.message_ru: Сайт заблокирован по IP-адресу: до сервера не доходит даже соединение. Обход DPI здесь не поможет, нужен VPN.

detection.rule: TCP connect succeeds, but after sending a ClientHello with the target SNI the client gets RST, a timeout or no ServerHello. The same IP with another SNI (e.g. a sibling host on the same infrastructure, as COMSS did for chatgpt.com vs auth.openai.com) completes TLS. Confirm by re-running with winws enabled: success = DPI-fixable.
detection.message_ru: Блокировка по имени сайта (DPI). Программа обхода как раз для этого — подбираем стратегию.

detection.rule: TLS and HTTP headers succeed, but the body stalls (no bytes for at least 5-8 s) after about 15-25 KB, while small requests under 10 KB complete. Fetch at least 64 KB (speed.cloudflare.com/__down?bytes=65536, a Hetzner Range request, or a large page) and compare against Content-Length or the expected size. The limit is about 25 packets in both directions, so 16 KB probes cannot detect it. Test per hosting group, because SNI/IP exceptions exist.
detection.message_ru: Провайдер обрезает соединение с этим зарубежным хостингом: страница начинает грузиться и зависает. Обход помогает не всегда — попробуем стратегии; если не выйдет, нужен VPN.

detection.rule: youtube.com loads (TLS OK, page complete), but a sustained googlevideo transfer (redirector.googlevideo.com/report_mapping or a videoplayback chunk) is slow or stalls. Measure throughput for at least 30 s; low single-digit hundreds of kbps (a 128 kbps cap was reported in 2024) or a stall = throttling. Also check i.ytimg.com separately. Report 'page opens, video does not' as its own state.
detection.message_ru: YouTube открывается, но видеопоток тормозят. Пробуем стратегии; также отключите QUIC в браузере и блокировщик рекламы. Если видео всё равно зависает, на вашей сети сейчас надёжно поможет только VPN.

detection.rule: Valid TLS with the real certificate for the host, plus an HTTP 403/451 with the provider's own body, e.g. OpenAI's 403 'Country, region, or territory not supported', or Docker's 403 where the normal answer is 401. Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/trace with 'loc=RU' shows the service sees a Russian IP. EXCLUDE bot challenges: a 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' / cf-mitigated challenge (faceit.com, store.epicgames.com) = reachable, not geo.
detection.message_ru: Сеть в порядке — это сам сервис отказывается работать с пользователями из России. Программа обхода блокировок здесь не поможет; нужен зарубежный IP-адрес.

detection.rule: A UDP 443 QUIC v1 handshake to the host fails while TCP 443 TLS to the same host succeeds. Probe QUIC once only: TSPU drops the 4-tuple for about 420 s after a hit, so repeated probes poison later tests.
detection.message_ru: Протокол QUIC (HTTP/3) к этому сайту заблокирован. Отключите QUIC в браузере — сайты будут работать через обычное соединение.

detection.rule: A TLS ClientHello with an ECH extension and outer SNI cloudflare-ech.com is dropped over TCP, while the same Cloudflare host without ECH works.
detection.message_ru: В вашем браузере включено шифрование имени сайта (ECH), а провайдер его блокирует. Отключите ECH в настройках браузера.

detection.rule: An HTTP response arrives, but the certificate does not match the requested host, or there is a redirect to an ISP or registry warning page. (This rule is reasoning, not sourced; verify with real samples.)
detection.message_ru: Провайдер подменяет страницу заглушкой о блокировке. Обычно это блокировка по реестру — попробуем обход.

detection.rule: Repeat every service test at least 3 times over several minutes; outcomes that differ between runs = unstable. Store a timestamp and the ISP name (ASN of the public IP) with every verdict. Statuses changed within hours to weeks in 2025-2026: ChatGPT reset for about 15 h, the GitHub outage on 14 Jul, PyPI in June, the Roblox block and unblock.
detection.message_ru: Доступ нестабильный: то работает, то нет. Это может быть временный сбой у провайдера или сервиса. Проверим ещё раз позже автоматически.

detection.rule: Discord voice (UDP 19294-19344/50000-50100), Telegram/WhatsApp calls (STUN), Telegram MTProto, game servers and account-level bans cannot be verified with HTTPS probes. Mark them 'не проверяется автоматически' instead of showing green.
detection.message_ru: Это нельзя проверить автоматически (голос, звонки, игровые серверы). Проверьте вручную после включения обхода.

detection.rule: Before testing, detect another active WinDivert driver (driverquery | find "Divert"; a stale 'windivert' service), a running GoodbyeDPI/winws, an active VPN/TUN adapter or a system proxy. If found, results are unreliable: offer cleanup first.
detection.message_ru: На компьютере уже работает другая программа обхода или VPN — результаты проверки будут неверными. Отключить её?

features.feature: One-button diagnosis screen: open the app, press 'Проверить', and get per-service cards (YouTube, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, ChatGPT, …) with a plain-Russian cause verdict: 'работает' / 'исправим обходом' / 'нужен защищённый DNS' / 'сервис сам не пускает Россию' / 'нужен VPN' / 'белые списки' / 'нет интернета' / 'не проверяется автоматически'. Modern card UI, one primary action per card.
features.why: This is the user's explicit request. Users cannot tell causes apart (Flowseal #18162, #10162). The closest competitor, m0xvi/zapret-gui v2.2.4, separates only DPI vs external vs strategy; no competitor checked separates geo-block, whitelist or IP block.

features.feature: Layered test engine per service: DNS (system vs several DoH) → TCP connect by IP → TLS with target SNI vs a neutral SNI on the same IP → HTTP status with known 'reachable' codes (401/403-challenge/404/400) → body of at least 64 KB → sustained throughput for video. Each layer maps to one detection rule.
features.why: Verified endpoint quirks: gateway.discord.gg 404, gql.twitch.tv 400, faceit/epic 403 challenge, Docker 401. A 16 KB probe cannot see the about-25-packet cut (hyperion-cs docs, Cloudflare blog). SNI comparison on the same IP is how the ChatGPT Sep 2026 incident was diagnosed (tproger/COMSS).

features.feature: DNS check plus one-click Secure DNS with fallback across several resolvers (dns.google, Cloudflare, Quad9, CleanBrowsing, NextDNS…), testing each before applying.
features.why: NSDI removal in Feb 2026 hit YouTube, WhatsApp, Meta and media (NGE, Mediazona). Secure DNS is step 1 in the Flowseal README. DoH/DoT were reported blocked on several ISPs in Aug 2026 (Anti-Malware, Risky Bulletin), and CleanBrowsing helped one user when others failed (#251).

features.feature: Mobile-whitelist and no-internet detection with an honest 'обход не поможет, подключитесь к Wi-Fi/проводу' message.
features.why: Whitelist mode has existed since Aug/Sep 2025. More than 60% of mobile sessions were restricted in H1 2026, and about 88% were on whitelists in Belgorod/Bryansk/Kursk on 2026-07-31 (CNews/Kommersant/Vigo; Mediazona; Rozetked).

features.feature: Automatic strategy selection: test the Flowseal strategies against the per-service targets, apply the best, and install it as a Windows service rather than a console window.
features.why: The README flow (service.bat → Run Tests → pick → Install Service) is console-driven. In #251 (Jul 2026) the bypass stopped when the terminal was closed.

features.feature: Conflict detector with one-click cleanup: other WinDivert drivers or a stale windivert service, GoodbyeDPI, VPN/TUN, Amnezia leftovers, system proxy.
features.why: Issue #522: these are the top causes of 'nothing launches' or 'RUNNING but sites dead'.

features.feature: YouTube-specific diagnostics: separate 'page opens / thumbnails / video stream' states, a sustained-playback test of at least 30 s, and guided fixes (disable QUIC/Kyber in the browser, Firefox http3 flags, disable ad blockers, try adding googlevideo.com to the UDP 443 rule).
features.why: Stalls after 10-30 min (#16448, Aug 2026), a black screen around 30 s on all strategies (#251, Oct 2026) and failures on older videos (Nov 2026). The FAQ lists QUIC/Kyber and ad blockers; disabling QUIC helped in Oct-Nov 2026.

features.feature: Background watchdog: re-test periodically and on network change, auto-switch the strategy after repeated failures, and show the last-checked time and ISP on every verdict.
features.why: Results change hour to hour and by ISP (#251 Nov 2026, issue #18 'unpredictable', Rostelecom vs MTS vs Beeline). Roblox was blocked and then unblocked within 6 months. m0xvi already ships a watchdog, so this is table stakes, not a differentiator.

features.feature: Telegram helper: explain that a strategy alone is unreliable, and offer optional tg-ws-proxy for Desktop and a hosts update for Web, with plain explanations.
features.why: The Flowseal README points Telegram users to tg-ws-proxy. Telegram had 86.8% OONI app anomalies in Oct-Nov 2026. A user in #17411 did not understand the optional TG proxy/WARP components.

features.feature: Discord voice helper: a separate voice status ('проверьте вручную'), a hosts-file update for *.discord.media, and UDP rule checks.
features.why: Voice fails independently of the web UI (Habr 1002160). #12487 '5к пинг' has 280 comments. The README says the hosts update fixes voice.

features.feature: Games mode toggle (Game Filter TCP/UDP 1024-65535, with UDP-only and custom options) with an anti-cheat warning and an automatic strategy restart. Show 'ipset any' only as a temporary test mode.
features.why: Game Filter is off by default and needs a restart (service.bat, #6800). Game issues dominate the top Flowseal threads (LoL #2354, Roblox #6795). The README warns that ipset any breaks many sites and that anti-cheats flag WinDivert.

features.feature: Safe updates for strategies, lists and the engine: SHA-256 verification, backup and rollback, no update while winws is running, and a pinned mirror fallback.
features.why: Flowseal shipped releases about monthly (1.10.0 on 22 Jul to 1.10.4 on 20 Oct 2026). 1.10.3 fixed GitHub downloads over IPv4/IPv6. There was a commit gap from 4 to 17 Jul 2026, and the suspension is unverified. EliteSpirit PR #3 shows the 'no update while winws runs' pattern.

features.feature: Proper installer to an ASCII path (e.g. under ProgramData), plus pre-flight checks for admin rights, Secure Boot driver blocks, ARM64 (no signed WinDivert), 32-bit and Win7.
features.why: The README requires a path without Cyrillic, special characters or spaces. zapret windows.md documents the Secure Boot, ARM64, 32-bit and Win7 limits.

features.feature: Shareable diagnosis report: a copyable plain-text summary with ISP, region, timestamp, per-layer results and strategy used, for asking help on forums.
features.why: Users in #251, #18162 and #10162 trade ISP-specific results by hand, and the #16448 FAQ has ISP-specific entries.

features.feature: 'Сбросить всё' and a clean uninstall: remove the service, WinDivert driver, hosts edits and DNS changes, and restore the previous settings.
features.why: Leftover windivert services break other tools (README, #522). The UnblockPro author stresses crash-safe cleanup (Habr 994412).

features.feature: Trust pack: published SHA-256 and VirusTotal link, code signing if feasible, a plain explanation of why admin rights and a driver are needed, and step-by-step AV exclusion guidance (Defender, Kaspersky 'legitimate apps').
features.why: WinDivert is flagged as RiskTool. The ZAPRET UI GUI hit a Defender ML 'Bearfoos' detection and 1/70 on VirusTotal, and its users feared a trojan (#17411). The README warns about fakes and malware found through Yandex search.

features.feature: Experimental calls profile (STUN magic-cookie filter, fake desync) clearly labelled 'экспериментально, проверьте звонком'.
features.why: Call blocking via STUN has been confirmed since Aug 2025 (Meduza), but the fix rests on a 2025 forum anecdote and a weak vendor article, with no 2026 data.

risks: Antivirus: WinDivert is detected as Not-a-virus:RiskTool.Multi.WinDivert and may be quarantined. GUI wrappers have triggered Defender ML detections (Trojan:Win32/Bearfoos.A!ml) and 1/70 VirusTotal hits. The app must explain this and guide exclusions, without ever silently disabling AV. Sources: Flowseal README; https://github.com/Flowseal/zapret-discord-youtube/discussions/17411

Anti-cheat: some anti-cheats flag WinDivert, so warn before Games mode. Roblox reportedly bans accounts for location masking via VPN (AppleInsider.ru 2026-06-10). Claude bans Russian accounts even after ID checks. Never recommend VPN for those accounts without the ban warning.

Conflicts: GoodbyeDPI, other zapret builds, VPN/TUN clients, leftover Amnezia files and stale windivert services break winws or invalidate test results (issue #522). Running EzPzDPI's zapret and GoodbyeDPI engines at the same time must be prevented.
Collateral breakage: 'ipset any' breaks many sites, and Game Filter can break things that worked before (README, release 1.10.1). Expose both only as temporary or advanced, with automatic rollback.
QUIC probing: TSPU penalises a blocked QUIC 4-tuple for about 420 s (FOCI 2026), so aggressive repeated QUIC tests can make the user's own connection worse for minutes.

False verdicts: Cloudflare bot challenges (faceit.com, store.epicgames.com 403), WebSocket hosts (gateway.discord.gg 404), gql.twitch.tv 400 and Docker 401 look like failures but are reachable. 16 KB probes miss the about-25-packet cut. A green check must never claim 'Discord voice works' or 'Telegram app works' from an HTTPS probe (UnblockPro v2.0 postmortem, Habr 1002160).

Over-promising: as of Nov 2026 no strategy is a universal YouTube fix (#251, #18162). Results vary by ISP and over time, and the contested Forbes report (18 Mar 2026) describes TSPU sometimes running in bypass mode. Always word verdicts as 'на вашей сети сейчас'.

Upstream supply chain: Flowseal is the strategy source. The repo is active (1.10.4 on 2026-10-20, last push 2026-11-04), but a July 2026 commit gap fits an outage. Pin versions, verify hashes, keep a fallback mirror, and do not cite the suspension as fact.

Regulatory pressure on the tool itself (verified context): by end of Feb 2026, 469 VPN services were blocked (re-russia). Marketplaces must restrict VPN users from Apr 2026. RKN demanded a record 233 bypass apps be removed from Google Play in Mar 2026 (iStories 2026-04-08). In Mar 2026 courts fined ISPs for letting users reach YouTube by bypassing TSPU (Mediazona 2026-04-07); these are fines on ISPs, not users. Expect distribution takedowns, and pushback on GitHub mirrors and app stores.

Legal note for users (NOT verified in this research; must be sourced before showing in the UI): none of the 7 research angles produced a verified 2025-2026 source on penalties for individual users of bypass tools, or on penalties for distributing or advertising them. From recollection, Russian laws from mid-2025 introduced fines for knowingly searching for 'extremist materials' (with VPN use as an aggravating circumstance) and banned advertising of VPN/bypass tools from Sep 2025. Treat both as unverified until checked against primary legal texts (pravo.gov.ru / Garant / Consultant) and reputable reporting. Until then the app should show only a neutral note: 'Использование средств обхода блокировок в России регулируется законом; программа не предназначена для доступа к запрещённым материалам. Разработчики не дают юридических консультаций.'
Privacy: diagnostics reveal the user's ISP and blocked-service usage. Keep all results local, send no telemetry by default, and require an explicit opt-in for any shared report.
gaps: No measurements from Russian IPs: all endpoint baselines were taken from a US IP. Real RU behaviour (RST vs timeout vs stall, stub pages, cert mismatches) must be collected from beta testers on Rostelecom, MTS, Beeline, MegaFon, Dom.ru and regional ISPs.
Whether zapret/winws strategies fix the 16-20 KB (about 25-packet) foreign-hosting throttling has no primary source. Needs per-host empirical testing.

Meta (Instagram/Facebook), X, LinkedIn, SoundCloud, Signal, Viber, TikTok and independent media: the 2026 network-level blocking mechanism (IP vs SNI vs signature) is unverified, so dpi_fixable stays 'partial = test it'.
Telegram: the exact 2026 mechanism (SNI vs IP vs MTProto signature) and whether winws alone helps on any ISP are unknown.
WhatsApp after the Feb 2026 full block: whether anything beyond Secure DNS (TCP/IP blocking, the STUN profile) helps is unknown. The Android MAU figures are unverified.
Call profiles (STUN desync) have no 2026 efficacy data.
Twitch: current status unknown. The June 2026 black-screen AWS-IP explanation is third-hand, and the SEO page with auto-generated dates was rejected.
Reddit, Pinterest, Medium, Rutracker, Wikipedia: no usable 2025-2026 source (gogov.ru unreachable). Live test only, so they are not in the catalog with a status.

Games with no usable source: Riot (Valorant/LoL), Genshin/HoYoverse, Brawl Stars/Supercell, Xbox Live/Minecraft login, PlayStation Network (only 2025 foreign-region account bans), Ubisoft. Steam/FACEIT/Battle.net statuses are only confirmed up to mid-2026.
Copilot, Canva, GitLab, npm: verification failed (vendor blog only, dead URL, unrelated citation). Docker Hub and Notion rest on 2024 sources only.
Geo-block response formats for Claude, Gemini, Spotify and Patreon are not documented. Only OpenAI's 403 message and Docker's 401-vs-403 split are known.
Cloudflare WARP 2026 status is unknown: it was reported blocked in 2022, yet a Nov 2026 admin used it as an exit. Users also report a Russian WARP exit since late Oct 2026.
DNS interception of plain UDP to 8.8.8.8/1.1.1.1 (redirect to 195.208.5.1) has a single-source basis (mentoday 2026-08-31). Which DoH providers currently work on which ISPs is unknown.

Mobile whitelist: the 20 Feb 2026 law/FSB clause and the '120+ services' count are only partly sourced. A home-ISP whitelist (Rostov, Mar 2026) is unconfirmed, and St Petersburg 4 Jul 2026 is unverified. No published algorithm for safe whitelist detection exists; ours is a derived design.

Legal penalties for individual users and for distributing or advertising bypass tools in 2025-2026: not researched by any angle. Needs a dedicated legal-source pass before any legal text ships in the UI.
Flowseal repo July 2026 suspension: unverified (the source is a dead Obsidian note). Mirrors (Gitea, FluxRoute, UnblockPro) are unverified.

Domains removed as invalid or misattributed: discord.status (no such TLD), discordpartygames.com (NXDOMAIN), telegram-cdn.org (on hold), yting.com (typo-squat), steamstat.info (not Steam), usercontent.dev and ton.org (not confirmed Telegram). Upstream Flowseal/itdoginfo lists still contain some of them; harmless in hostlists but never use them as test targets.

verificationSummaries.summary:
Model: Opus 5.5, single agent. Checked all 25 cited URLs on 2026-11-16. 20 were live at the first try and ura.news was live on retry (first try was a 504). Two are dead: both publish.obsidian.md pages return 404. Three cannot be read: gogov.ru returns a 429 bot CAPTCHA on every page. Every domain in the service entries is real: each appears in the live Flowseal or itdoginfo raw lists or resolves in DNS. None look invented.

Endpoint bugs that would break the diagnostic: cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query returns 400 unless the request sends 'accept: application/dns-json'; gateway.discord.gg returns 404 and gql.twitch.tv returns 400 to a plain GET. Treat any TLS/HTTP response as 'reachable' for those.

Strongest evidence (secondary-tier news and analysis, Feb-Sep 2026): Meduza, Novaya Gazeta Europe, ura.news, Moscow Times, re-russia and Snob back the NSDI/DNS removal, the list of 13 resources, the Meta/WhatsApp/Discord/LinkedIn/Patreon timeline and the whitelists.

Weak or failed: the Twitch status comes only from an SEO page that inserts today's date into its headings daily. The Reddit, Pinterest, Medium and Rutracker claims depend on unreachable gogov.ru. The Flowseal July 2026 suspension relies on a dead Obsidian note; the GitHub API shows the repo active, with release 1.10.4 on 2026-10-20.

Date fixes: the YouTube stall reports are from 2-4 Aug 2026, not 25-26 Jul. The Forbes TSPU-overload report is from 18 Mar 2026 and is disputed by experts. Snob's whitelist piece is dated 19 Mar 2026. The hosting-provider VPN ban was adopted, not just planned, per a vendor blog.

New and relevant for the YouTube diagnostic: Flowseal users in Nov 2026 report that older videos fail while popular ones load, which they blame on degraded YouTube caching servers inside Russia. They also say WARP has given a Russian exit since late October, and that disabling QUIC or adding googlevideo.com to the UDP 443 rule helped some of them.

Totals: 23 pass, 22 partial, 5 fail; 0 left unverified. Text extracts of the sources are in <local scratch>

I checked 11 claims, 10 service entries and 7 UX findings: 15 pass, 13 partial, 0 fail. All 23 cited URLs were probed. Two did not load. (1) securitylab.ru/news/578976.php returns HTTP 401 behind a Qrator bot wall and has no Wayback snapshot, so the WhatsApp Android MAU figures (82M to 57.9M) are UNVERIFIED. (2) dtf.ru/howto/4814603-zoom-v-rossii-v-2026-godu returns 404. I replaced it with OONI API data: zoom.us has 1.3% anomalies in RU, which supports not_blocked.
